analysis.title: Glass Half Full? Morgan Stanley Says So... 65% Momentum Crashes, A 2008 Gold Flashback, & A French Bond Crisis Say Otherwise
key_insights: Tech Momentum recorded 65 absolute moves >5% in 2026 YTD, nearly matching the 70 such moves across 1999-2001 combined. MS US TMT momentum factor (MSZZTMTM) is down 62% from its highs.
40% of US L/S funds are negative YTD, while the Russell 1000 Equal Weight gained 2% in October against an 18% decline in the MS AI basket (MSXXAI). Index gains mask losses in the crowded AI trade.

US L/S momentum (MSZZMOMO) fell 7.9% on Thursday, its worst day in three years. US L/S net leverage fell a point to 47% (2nd percentile over the past year) and gross leverage rose 3 points to 210% (94th percentile since 2010) on mechanical increases from PnL losses.
October L/S performance: Americas L/S -2.6% MTD vs S&P +1.3%, Europe L/S -2.2% vs STOXX 600 +0.9%, Asia L/S -4.5% vs MSCI Asia Pacific -5.5%.

AI Infrastructure still accounts for about 35% of US funds' net exposure after reductions. Goldman's PB desk showed funds sold the most tech stock since September 2024 and nets are at a one-year low, which Goldman reads as a buy-the-dip setup.

MS QDS: S&P 500 dispersion is in the 83rd percentile over five years, and the ratio of between-sector to within-sector dispersion is in the 89th percentile, so macro and thematic bets (AI) are driving the damage.

Earnings are solid: 80% of US companies beat EPS expectations and 3Q S&P EPS is expected to grow 27% on 11% sales growth. Surprise magnitude and the market's reward for beats are below historical norms. 44% of S&P 500 market cap reports next week, hyperscalers included.

Market focus is shifting from how much companies invest to how effectively spending converts into growth and profitability. Meta fell after its CDS hit a record on capex concerns. Lam Research fell 10% on December-quarter revenue guidance of $8.6B +/- $400M vs about $9.0B expected. OpenAI trimmed its valuation target to $1.25 trillion.

MS's Erik Woodring says Western Digital is firing on all cylinders: revenue growth accelerating toward 70% YoY, incremental margins of about 80%, price per terabyte up 28% YoY in September (heading above 30% in December), and demand visibility through 2031 from its seven largest customers.

MS chief equity strategist Mike Wilson: since mid-August the quality factor gained about 6% while the equal-weight S&P 500 fell nearly 4%. The earnings revisions spread between high and low quality is nearly 10%. He calls it a mid-cycle transition and would use any S&P catch-down to add risk in higher-quality cyclicals. Financial conditions are the tightest since 2022 and Chair Warsh's response is important to ending the correction.

MS's Andrew Sheets: 10Y yields are up about 100bps this year and IG spreads are near historic tights, but pressure is spreading beneath the surface. Over half of the Russell 3000 is down at least 20% since June and US CCC spreads are 400bps wider YTD.

One of the largest weekly increases in the US Inflation Surprise Index in five years coincided with the 10Y Treasury's biggest weekly yield decline in 14 months. Thursday's 17bp drop in 10Y yields was the biggest one-day drop since March 2023, driven by an AI funding scare that turned an oil spike into a bond rally.

MS's Michael Gapen sees 3Q real GDP at 3.1% annualized on 3.7% consumption growth, slowing to 1.9% in 4Q and 1.5% in 1Q27. He expects the Fed to hold next week, then hike 25bps in December and again in March, which conflicts with the bond market pricing a growth scare.

Gold fell 2.8% on Thursday despite Nasdaq -2.9%, dollar -0.2%, 10Y yields -17bps and real yields -14bps. The last time gold performed this badly on an equivalent 10Y yield move was December 2008, a period of margin-call-driven liquidation. Gold broke below $4,000 this week.

France: the OAT-Bund spread widened from 138bps to 171bps in a week, French 3Q GDP is tracking 0.1% QoQ, and French spreads are 55bp over Greece. The CAC/STOXX 600 ratio is at a record low. MS's Jens Eisenschmidt expects the 2027 budget to stabilize rather than meaningfully reduce the deficit, with no budget clarity until late November or mid-December. Moody's took no action in its Friday review. 70,000 police were deployed as cities braced for a second weekend of riots.

Europe: STOXX 600 had its best week since early July (+2.1%) while cyclicals underperformed defensives by 4.7%. EU Software outperformed Semis by more than 100% in four months, the European net beat rate halved to +20% from +40% in 2Q, and the EU 12M momentum pair is the most oversold since 2014. MS notes the median six-month return after such readings is close to 10%.

Asia: Japan and Korea are both down about 7-8% since October 14, Japan's momentum trade fell nearly 14% while Korean momentum recovered 6% in three sessions. China A-share sentiment is near July 2024 lows for a third week and Southbound investors pulled $1.9B during October 15-21. MS's Laura Wang removed CATL from her Focus List.

Diesel: MS's Martijn Rats says refinery runs in Russia and the Middle East are tracking about 3 million b/d below last year (about 10% of seaborne supply). Scheduled maintenance rises by 3.4 million b/d between 4Q26 and 2Q27, about 2.5x the norm.
MS's Adam Wood assumed coverage of CoreWeave at Equal-weight with a $70 PT, citing financing uncertainty reducing visibility into deploying contracted capacity.

Midterms: prediction markets assign a 90% chance of Republicans losing the House. MS's Ariana Salvatore says a status quo result is most bullish for AI sentiment and a Democratic sweep is most bearish (more state-level data center pushback). Next catalysts are the December 11 funding deadline and the debt limit.
Next week: 44% of S&P market cap reports, and the Fed, ECB and BoJ all meet.

tension_points.bull_case: Goldman's PB desk reads one-year-low net exposure and the largest tech selling since September 2024 as a buy-the-dip setup, and 80% of companies beat EPS with 3Q EPS growth expected at 27%.
tension_points.bear_case: Beats are rewarded less than historical norms, the market is focused on capex returns (Meta CDS at a record, Lam down 10%), AI infrastructure is still about 35% of net exposure, and Nomura calls the AI glass totally empty.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Hyperscaler earnings next week, with 44% of S&P 500 market cap reporting, fail to show capex converting into growth and profitability.

tension_points.bull_case: The bond market is pricing a growth scare, with the biggest weekly 10Y yield decline in 14 months, and long duration hedges equities.
tension_points.bear_case: MS economists expect the Fed to hold next week, then hike 25bps in December and again in March, with inflation surprises rising.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A Fed hold with dovish guidance next week, or an inflation surprise reversal, would settle the conflict toward the bond market's view.

tension_points.bull_case: EU 12M momentum is the most oversold since 2014, a reading with a median six-month return near 10%.
tension_points.bear_case: The same oversold signal was typically positive for US tech momentum until it failed, and the European net beat rate has halved to +20% from +40%.
